date_published.why: The IDFPR release (4 Aug 2025) says the Governor signed "on Friday", that is 1 Aug 2025; announcement, so alt-official and level B is right.

summary_claims.claim: Prohibits anyone from using AI to provide mental health and therapeutic decision-making; fine of up to $10,000

note: Everything rests on the IDFPR release (alt-official, correctly labelled). The Public Act number and General Assembly are not in a stored source, and the record keeps them only in official_identifier, which this run does not change. A search found Public Act 104-0054 on ilga.gov and no 2026 amendment.
